entry_item.definition: v.t. To throw, fling; to throw down (in wrestling); to throw away, give up, discard, abandon, reject; to lose; to have a miscarriage ( of domestic animals); to swing the arms.

example.definition: To leave [one's] work; to go on strike.

entry_item.definition: v.t. To throw. To fling. To cast away. To reject. To drop (calves etc.). Miscarriage.
